watchNewFiles.label: Watch New Files
watchNewFiles.description: Triggers when a file is uploaded to Nubbo, through the app, a file request, an embed or the API.

watchNewInboxUploads.label: Watch New File Request Uploads
watchNewInboxUploads.description: Triggers when someone uploads a file through a file request.

watchNewActivity.label: Watch New Activity
watchNewActivity.description: Triggers when something happens in the space: files, folders, trash, labels, share links, file requests, galleries, embeds and automation rules.

listFiles.label: List Files in a Folder
listFiles.description: Lists the files and folders in a folder of a bucket.

searchFiles.label: Search Files
searchFiles.description: Searches files and folders by name, kind, extension, labels, size and date.

getFile.label: Get a File or Folder
getFile.description: Gets the details of a file or a folder.

createFolder.label: Create a Folder
createFolder.description: Creates a folder, and any missing parent folders.

renameFile.label: Rename a File or Folder
renameFile.description: Renames a file or a folder. A large folder rename runs in the background and returns an operation.

moveFiles.label: Move Files and Folders
moveFiles.description: Moves files and folders to a folder, in the same bucket or another one. Large moves run in the background and return an operation.

getOperation.label: Get an Operation
getOperation.description: Gets the progress of a move or a rename that runs in the background.

getDownloadLink.label: Get a Download Link
getDownloadLink.description: Creates a temporary link that downloads a file straight from the storage provider.

addFileLabel.label: Add a Label to a File
addFileLabel.description: Adds a label to a file or a folder.

removeFileLabel.label: Remove a Label from a File
removeFileLabel.description: Removes a label from a file or a folder.

uploadFile.label: Upload a File
uploadFile.description: Uploads a file straight to the storage provider of a bucket, in one request.

downloadFile.label: Download a File
downloadFile.description: Downloads a file straight from the storage provider of its bucket.

startUpload.label: Start an Upload
startUpload.description: Starts an upload and returns the presigned URL, or the part size and count of a multipart upload. Send the bytes yourself, then complete it.

signUploadParts.label: Sign Upload Parts
signUploadParts.description: Returns presigned URLs for parts of a multipart upload.

completeUpload.label: Complete an Upload
completeUpload.description: Completes an upload once its bytes are at the provider, and returns the file.

abortUpload.label: Abort a Multipart Upload
abortUpload.description: Aborts a multipart upload and frees its parts at the provider.

trashFiles.label: Move Files to the Trash
trashFiles.description: Moves files and folders to the trash.

restoreFiles.label: Restore Files from the Trash
restoreFiles.description: Restores files and folders from the trash.

listTrash.label: List the Trash
listTrash.description: Lists the files and folders in the trash.

listLabels.label: List Labels
listLabels.description: Lists the labels of the space.

createLabel.label: Create a Label
createLabel.description: Creates a label. Needs a key that reaches the whole space with read and write access.

updateLabel.label: Update a Label
updateLabel.description: Changes the name, color, description or group of a label.

mergeLabels.label: Merge Labels
mergeLabels.description: Merges a label into another one: its files get the other label, and it is deleted.

deleteLabel.label: Delete a Label
deleteLabel.description: Deletes a label and takes it off every file.

listLabelGroups.label: List Label Groups
listLabelGroups.description: Lists the label groups of the space.

listProjects.label: List Projects
listProjects.description: Lists the projects the key reaches.

getProject.label: Get a Project
getProject.description: Gets a project with its folders and resource counts.

addProjectItems.label: Add Items to a Project
addProjectItems.description: Adds folders, share links, file requests, galleries, embeds and automation rules to a project.

removeProjectItems.label: Remove Items from a Project
removeProjectItems.description: Removes folders and resources from a project.

listShareLinks.label: List Share Links
listShareLinks.description: Lists the share links the key reaches.

listInboxUploads.label: List File Request Uploads
listInboxUploads.description: Lists the files a file request received.

listFileRequests.label: List File Requests
listFileRequests.description: Lists the file requests the key reaches.

listGalleries.label: List Galleries
listGalleries.description: Lists the galleries the key reaches.

listEmbeds.label: List Embeds
listEmbeds.description: Lists the embeds the key reaches.

listAutomationRules.label: List Automation Rules
listAutomationRules.description: Lists the automation rules the key reaches.

listActivity.label: List Activity
listActivity.description: Lists the activity of the space, newest first.

getAccount.label: Get the API Key and Quota
getAccount.description: Gets the space, plan, key and monthly quota of this connection. It does not count as a request.

listBuckets.label: List Buckets
listBuckets.description: Lists the buckets the key reaches.

makeApiCall.label: Make an API Call
makeApiCall.description: Performs an authorized call to any endpoint of the Nubbo API.

origins.label: Nubbo
origins.baseUrl: -FILL-ME- the API URL of the Make zone, for example https://eu2.make.com/api
origins.appId: -FILL-ME- the app ID that Make shows after you create the app
